newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan August jobless rate at 10-yr high 3.19 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan August jobless rate at 10-yr high 3.19 pct.

text.p: Taiwan's unemployment was at 3.19 percent in August, up from 2.97 in July and the highest rate since it hit 3.11 percent in August 1986, the Directorate General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics said on Monday.
The bureau attributed the decade-high unemployment to continued inflows of new school graduates into the labour market.
Unemployment among college graduates hit 4.19 percent, rising 0.14 percentage points in August from July. Unemployment rate among senior high school graduates was at 3.53 percent.
The number of unemployed people in August increased 21,000 to 297,000 from July, while the number of employed decreased 30,000 to 8.996 million.
Of the unemployed people, a total of 92,000 people were first-time job seekers.
